text:
## Purpose  
Define how FirstUK selects the controlling document when guidance overlaps,
changes over time, or disagrees.
name: Chunk 2/6

raw_entities.name: Document Control and Hierarchy Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK's formal policy establishing the hierarchy and selection criteria for controlling documents when regulatory guidance, internal policies, or procedural documentation overlap, conflict, or change over time. This policy defines which document takes precedence in cases of disagreement or temporal inconsistency.
context: Define how FirstUK selects the controlling document when guidance overlaps, changes over time, or disagrees.

raw_entities.name: FirstUK
raw_entities.description: The banking organisation subject to this document control and hierarchy policy. FirstUK is establishing formal procedures to manage conflicting or overlapping guidance.
context: Define how FirstUK selects the controlling document when guidance overlaps, changes over time, or disagrees.
